familiar.en: For the majority of you listening, you are likely most familiar with “linear time”.
familiar.zh: 这就是时间沿直线流逝的观点。

familiar.en: So while events happen in different contexts, they often follow familiar paths.​
familiar.zh: 因此，尽管事件发生在不同的背景下，它们往往遵循熟悉的轨迹。

familiar.en: Brandy Drew has a story that may sound familiar to you, a story of poverty and debt.
familiar.zh: Brandy Drew 有一个对你来说可能并不陌生的故事，一个关于贫穷和债务的故事。

familiar.en: When a disease spreads rapidly, our reactions often follow very familiar patterns.
familiar.zh: 当疾病迅速传播时，我们的反应往往遵循非常熟悉的模式。

familiar.en: I sat with a guy called Gabor Mate. I don't know if you're familiar with Gabor.
familiar.zh: 我曾和一位叫Gabor Mate的人坐下来谈过。不知道你是否熟悉Gabor。

fair.en: And to be fair, the dream is closer to reality than it was in 2022.
fair.zh: 公平地说，这个梦想比 2022 年时更接近现实了。

fair.en: A stigma is a negative belief about something which is not necessarily true or fair.
fair.zh: “污名”（stigma）是指对某事物的负面看法，这种看法不一定真实或公平。

fair.en: So, you're a family man, Neil. Do you do your fair share of household chores?
fair.zh: 所以，尼尔，你是个顾家的男人。你承担了你那份公平的家务吗？

fair.en: At this point, I think it’s worth stepping back and considering whether these changes are fair.
fair.zh: 此时，我认为有必要退一步思考这些变化是否公平。

fair.en: If you do your fair share of work, you do a reasonable amount.
fair.zh: 如果你尽了自己那份公平的责任，你就是做了合理的份额。

fairly.en: All right, so you actually looked in a fairly systematic, empirical way at baseball players.
fairly.zh: 好的，所以你实际上以一种相当系统、实证的方式研究了棒球运动员。

fairly.en: At the end of Richard's budget process, the math they come up with is fairly stark.
fairly.zh: 在理查德的预算流程接近尾声时，他们算出来的数学账目可以说是相当严峻。

fairly.en: They trust these tests to fairly and accurately measure a person’s ability.
fairly.zh: 他们信任这些测试能够公平、准确地衡量一个人的能力。

fairly.en: I am fairly confident that it is b) – food put on a hook.
fairly.zh: 我相当确信答案是 b）——放在钩子上的食物。

fairly.en: But we're used to these fairly long cycles, multi-year cycles in which we are committed to things.
fairly.zh: 但我们习惯了这些相当长的周期，多年周期，我们致力于某些事情。

farmer.en: Farmers cultivated crops like maize (which is corn), beans, squash, and chili peppers.
farmer.zh: 农民种植了诸如玉米（也就是玉米）、豆类、南瓜和辣椒等农作物。

farmer.en: Darwin also studied selective breeding, which is a process used by farmers and animal breeders.
farmer.zh: Darwin还研究了人工选择，这是农民和动物育种者使用的一种方法。

farmer.en: And you know, for some farmers that are very remote, that comes also with a challenge.
farmer.zh: 而且你知道，对于一些非常偏远的农民来说，这也带来了一个挑战。

farmer.en: Farmers who were poor mostly focused on how to make it to next week - short-term thinking.
farmer.zh: 贫穷的农民主要关注如何撑到下周——短视思维。

farmer.en: Fertilizers are used by farmers to improve the growth of their crops.
farmer.zh: 化肥被农民用来促进作物的生长。

favour.en: Another argument in favour of the minimum wage is that it increases consumer spending.
favour.zh: 另一个支持最低工资的论点是它能增加消费支出。

favour.en: Kate is very pro- science. If you're pro- something, it means you're in favour of it.
favour.zh: Kate非常支持科学。如果你“pro-”某事，意味着你赞成它。

favour.en: Foreign music was pushed aside in favour of homegrown styles.
favour.zh: 外国音乐被推到一旁，取而代之的是本土风格。

favour.en: If you're pro- something, you're in favour of it.
favour.zh: 如果你“pro-”某事，你就是赞成它。

favour.en: Mobutu ruled through a complex web of patronage, of dispersing power, favours and money to his family, friends and allies.
favour.zh: 蒙博托通过复杂的裙带关系网络进行统治，将权力、恩惠和金钱分发给他的家人、朋友和盟友。

fare.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Pippa. Sharing your Netflix password, lying about your age or not paying the bus fare are a few examples of cheating in daily life.
fare.zh: 我是尼尔。我是皮帕。在日常生活中，共享Netflix密码、隐瞒年龄或逃公交车票都是作弊的例子。

fan.en: So, the ground is shaking, music is blasting, and thousands of fans are dancing.
fan.zh: 所以，地面在震动，音乐在轰鸣，成千上万的粉丝在跳舞。

fan.en: To his fans, he was a saviour, the strongman Egypt needed to stop the chaos.
fan.zh: 在他的粉丝看来，他是拯救者，是埃及制止混乱所需要的强人。

fan.en: If you are not an NFL fan, you probably don’t know who Jordan Mailata is.
fan.zh: 如果你不是NFL球迷，你可能不知道乔丹·马拉塔是谁。

fan.en: Yeah, it's just, as a fan I listened to music all the time.
fan.zh: 我爱上了它。我想尽一切办法参与其中。那时嘻哈音乐刚在纽约兴起。

fan.en: I'm a big fan of breakfast foods and eggs are my favourite.
fan.zh: 我是早餐食品的超级粉丝，鸡蛋是我的最爱。

fascinate.en: He was fascinated by numbers, patterns, and by how the natural world worked.
fascinate.zh: 他对外数字、规律以及自然界的运作方式着迷不已。

fascinate.en: He would become fascinated by a new idea, move on, and not complete his previous work.
fascinate.zh: 他会对一个新想法着迷，然后转移注意力，不再完成之前的工作。

fascinate.en: And it was there, in military school, that he became fascinated with the idea of change.
fascinate.zh: 也正是在那里，在军事学校里，他开始对变革的理念着迷。

fascinate.en: But, while Leonardo is best known as an artist, he was also fascinated by how the world worked.
fascinate.zh: 但是，尽管列奥纳多最著名的身份是艺术家，他也对世界的运作方式充满好奇。

fascinate.en: Eldar remembers being immediately fascinated by the study and how the lack of food affected the minds of the men.
fascinate.zh: Eldar 回忆说，他立刻被这项研究以及食物匮乏如何影响这些男人的心理所吸引。

false.en: T here were also some interesting “false friends” that I encountered while learning to drive.
false.zh: 在学开车时，我还遇到了一些有趣的的“假同源词”（False friends）。

false.en: He had escaped to Argentina after the war and had been living under a false name.
false.zh: 战后他逃往阿根廷，一直隐姓埋名生活。

false.en: Ancient leaders, medieval kings and 20th century dictators all used false information to influence people.
false.zh: 古代的统治者、中世纪的国王以及20世纪的独裁者都曾利用虚假信息来影响民众。

false.en: False claims about vaccines, miracle cures, government conspiracies, and the origins of the virus circulated everywhere.
false.zh: 关于疫苗、奇迹疗法、政府阴谋以及病毒来源的虚假声明到处流传。

false.en: If something shatters your illusions, it destroys a false belief you hold, making you realise an unpleasant truth.
false.zh: 如果某事打破了你的幻觉，它就摧毁了你持有的一种错误信念，让你意识到一个令人不快的事实。

fashionable.en: It's something humans have always done and recently it's become fashionable among groups of young people.
fashionable.zh: 这是人类一直在做的事情，最近在年轻人中变得流行起来。

fashionable.en: French cuisine became really fashionable in Britain, among the wealthy classes anyway.
fashionable.zh: 法国料理在英国变得非常流行，至少在富裕阶层中是这样。

fashionable.en: Wealthy Europeans loved fashionable hats made from beaver fur particularly.
fashionable.zh: 富有的欧洲人格外喜爱用海狸毛皮制作的时尚帽子。

fashionable.en: Coolcation is a holiday somewhere cool. Not cool as in fashionable, but cool in temperature, often taken to escape extreme heat.
fashionable.zh: Coolcation 指的是去凉爽地方度假，这里的“cool”不是指时髦，而是指气温低，通常是为了躲避酷暑。

fashionable.en: A great resort of gallants is an unusual phrase, and not something you'd hear nowadays, but it just means a fashionable crowd.
fashionable.zh: “大量时髦的上流社会人士”（A great resort of gallants）是一个不寻常的短语，现在已经听不到了，但它其实就是指时髦的人群。

fashion.en: One example of a kind of production that degrowthers disagree with is fast fashion.
fashion.zh: “减增长主义者”反对的一种生产方式就是快时尚。

fashion.en: Can you remember when computer floppy disks, hand-held Game Boys, and fax machines were in fashion?
fashion.zh: 你还记得电脑软盘、手掌游戏机Game Boy和传真机风靡一时的时代吗？

fashion.en: An example of those elements would be fast fashion, private jets, the beef and meat industry.
fashion.zh: 这些要素的例子包括快时尚、私人飞机、牛肉和肉类产业。

fashion.en: Today the idea is back in fashion, with kids playing not in bombsites but in 'junk playgrounds', also called 'adventure playgrounds'.
fashion.zh: 如今这个想法又流行起来了，孩子们不再在炸弹废墟中玩耍，而是在“垃圾游乐场”里玩，也被称为“冒险游乐场”。

fashion.en: I'm Beth. And I'm Pippa. Everywhere you look online, from gaming and fashion to music, travel and culture, you'll find social media influencers.
fashion.zh: 我是 Beth。我是 Pippa。在网上的任何角落，从游戏、时尚到音乐、旅行和文化，你都能看到社交媒体网红。

fascinating.en: I think what makes Warsaw fascinating is that it has this mixture of histories.
fascinating.zh: 我认为华沙最迷人的地方在于它融合了多种历史。

fascinating.en: In practice, though, it’s a position that’s evolved in fascinating and, sometimes, contradictory ways.
fascinating.zh: 但在实践中，这个职位却以迷人且有时甚至是矛盾的方式发展着。

fascinating.en: No Polish state. This is one of the most fascinating, extraordinary parts of Polish history.
fascinating.zh: 没有波兰国。这是波兰历史上最迷人、最非凡的部分之一。

fascinating.en: And as these animals changed their behaviour, something fascinating happened to their bodies.
fascinating.zh: 随着这些动物的行为发生改变，它们的身体也发生了一些奇妙的变化。

fascinating.en: These are interesting words and are connected to some fascinating changes and problems in modern society!
fascinating.zh: 这些都是有趣的词汇，并且与现代社会中一些迷人的变化和问题息息相关！

fantastic.en: Yes, I think 'strange', 'mysterious' and 'fantastic' describe being a twin quite well.
fantastic.zh: 是的，我觉得“奇怪”、“神秘”和“神奇”把双胞胎的特质描述得很贴切。

fantastic.en: And finally,if someone says,"It was crazy!" they mean it was strange and fantastic.
fantastic.zh: 最后，如果有人说，“太疯狂了！”，他们的意思是这又奇怪又神奇。

fantastic.en: And in part three, we’ll talk about the fantastic linguistic and cultural concept of enshittification.
fantastic.zh: 而在第三部分，我们会聊聊“enshittification”这个精彩的语言与文化概念。

fantastic.en: What do you think of DOGE? Do you think it’s a fantastic idea and that every country should follow its example, that it was a terrible, politicised plot, or somewhere in between?
fantastic.zh: 你怎么看 DOGE？你认为这是一个绝妙的主意，每个国家都应该效仿它，还是一个糟糕的、充满政治色彩的阴谋，抑或是介于两者之间？

fantastic.en: Firstly, although you might imagine one of these “grand nez” to always smell fantastic, and to be covered head to toe with fragrance when they come into the office in the morning, they aren’t.
fantastic.zh: 首先，虽然你可能会想象这些“grand nez”闻起来总是棒极了，早晨一进办公室就从头到脚喷满香水，但事实并非如此。

fake.en: That's fake. There are a multitude of ways to discuss any issue and any topic.
fake.zh: 那是假的。讨论任何议题和话题都有多种方式。

fake.en: He had faked his own death and had been living in Australia under a fake name.
fake.zh: 他伪造了自己的死亡，并一直以假名住在澳大利亚。

fake.en: He had faked his own death and had been living in Australia under a fake name.
fake.zh: 他伪造了自己的死亡，并一直以假名住在澳大利亚。

fake.en: It's fake science. I saw the Icaut replication crisis hard recently.
fake.zh: 这是伪科学。我最近看到冰激凌重复危机（译者注：原文icaut应为replication crisis即心理学可重复性危机）非常严重。

fake.en: When anything can be faked, when anything can be made by a computer, people begin to doubt everything.
fake.zh: 当任何东西都可以被伪造，当任何东西都可以由电脑制造时，人们开始对一切产生怀疑。

fabric.en: The puppeteer stands hidden inside a simple vertical fabric booth, holds his hands above his head, and operates the puppets from below.
fabric.zh: 木偶师藏在一个简单的垂直布罩里面，把双手举过头顶，从下方操纵木偶。

fabric.en: And if you’ve seen clips of people standing up in an old-looking room with wooden benches with green fabric, shouting at each other, this is what’s happening.
fabric.zh: 如果你看过人们站在一个铺着绿色织物木质长椅、看起来很有年代感的房间里互相大喊大叫的片段，这就是正在发生的事情。

faithful.en: Odysseus recognises him as Argos, his old faithful hunting dog.
faithful.zh: 奥德修斯认出他是阿耳戈斯，自己过去忠实的猎犬。

faithful.en: OK, then, that is it for today's episode on dogs, our faithful, canine partners for tens of thousands of years.
faithful.zh: 好了，以上就是今天关于狗的节目的全部内容，它们是我们忠实且陪伴了人类数万年的犬类伙伴。

faithful.en: But this one did. By all accounts, George adored her, and was faithful to her for their 57-year union.
faithful.zh: 但这桩婚姻却很美满。据各方记载，George 深爱着她，并在长达 57 年的婚姻中对她忠贞不渝。

faithful.en: So historians today are not entirely sure how much of what he wrote down in 1828 was a faithful record of what Piccini actually performed, and how much was tidied up, polished, or simply invented.
faithful.zh: 因此，今天的历史学家并不完全确定他在 1828 年写下的内容中，有多少是对 Piccini 实际表演的忠实记录，又有多少是被美化、润色或纯粹虚构出来的。

fahrenheit.en: Both had been heated to temperatures of around 500 degrees Celsius, almost 1,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
fahrenheit.zh: 两者都被加热到约 500 摄氏度的高温，也就是将近 1,000 华氏度。

fame.en: Now, Earp had been thinking about fame and how it worked for a long time.
fame.zh: 其实，Earp 早就一直在琢磨名气这回事，以及它究竟是怎么运作的。

fame.en: But the kind of fame that's earned because you did something useful, why dodge that?
fame.zh: 但那种因为你做了有用的事而赢得的名气，为什么要回避呢？

fame.en: So let's try it. Was money or fame or anything part of that?
fame.zh: 所以我们试试吧。金钱、名声或者其他什么东西是其中的一部分吗？

fame.en: Well, fame doesn't help on that one because that is one of the traps of fame.
fame.zh: 嗯，名气在这方面没什么帮助，因为这是名气的陷阱之一。

fame.en: I often say to people, you know, I'm unlucky that a part of my job comes with fame.
fame.zh: 我常对人说，你知道，我不走运，因为我的工作的一部分伴随着名声。

faction.en: Among its members is a more radical faction, led by a socialist named Ali Soilih.
faction.zh: 在其成员中，有一个由名叫 Ali Soilih 的社会主义者领导的更为激进的派系。

faction.en: It was seen as a job for those who'd either failed to win the presidency outright or who needed to satisfy a particular political faction within the government.
faction.zh: 当时这被视为一份给那些竞选总统失败、或者需要用来安抚政府内部某个特定政治派别的人准备的工作。

faction.en: It was a motley crew, but what did unite them was a firm belief that Adolf Hitler needed to be removed from power, and killing him and pinning the blame on “rebel factions” was the best way of doing it.
faction.zh: 这是一群乌合之众，但将他们团结在一起的是一种坚定的信念：必须将阿道夫·希特勒赶下台，而杀死他并将罪名归咎于“反叛派系”是实现这一目标的最佳途径。

fabrication.en: Now, there is plenty of evidence to suggest that this official version is a fabrication, and suspicion has long fallen on Denard.
fabrication.zh: 然而，有充分的证据表明这一官方版本纯属伪造，长久以来人们一直怀疑是 Bob Denard 所为。

famine.en: One of the most significant migrations came during the Irish potato famine of the 1840s.
famine.zh: 其中最重要的一次人口迁徙发生在1840年代的爱尔兰大饥荒期间。

famine.en: You know: Concert for Bangladesh and the famine and the revolution and the miserable history of Bangladesh in the 1970s.
famine.zh: 你知道的：“孟加拉国援助演唱会”、大饥荒、独立战争，还有孟加拉国在上世纪七十年代那段悲惨的历史。

famine.en: The results of the starvation experiment were eventually published and remain an important academic reference on nutrition, famine and eating disorders.
famine.zh: 这项饥饿实验的结果最终得以发表，并至今仍是营养学、饥荒和进食障碍领域重要的学术参考资料。

famine.en: Europe is on the verge of mass famine. Aid workers desperately need guidance on how to bring people back from the brink of starvation.
famine.zh: 欧洲正处于大规模饥荒的边缘。救援人员迫切需要指导，以了解如何将人们从饥饿的边缘拯救回来。

famine.en: The human cost was devastating. Hundreds of thousands of people died — from battle, from the famines that followed the destruction of the countryside, and from disease.
famine.zh: 伤亡人数是毁灭性的。数十万人死亡——死于战斗、死于破坏乡村后引发的饥荒，以及死于疾病。

fade.en: Surveillance has become such a normal part of life that it fades into the background.
fade.zh: 监控已经成为生活中如此平常的一部分，以至于它淡入了背景之中。

fade.en: The struggle for Arab independence continued for decades, and resentment towards Western involvement never faded.
fade.zh: 阿拉伯独立的斗争持续了数十年，对西方干预的怨恨从未消退。

fade.en: Sudhir Venkatesh, the sociologist who talked to fading baseball players for us, he’s also been asking prostitutes about quitting.
fade.zh: 苏迪尔·文卡特什，那个为我们采访过走下坡路的棒球运动员的社会学家，他也一直在问妓女们关于退出的事。

fade.en: That talk seems to have faded. And there's more talk that the next few years will feel like the 1970s.
fade.zh: 那种论调似乎已经渐渐平息了。现在更多的讨论是，未来几年感觉会很像20世纪70年代。

fade.en: But with the fall of the Roman Empire, perfume’s prominence faded in much of Europe, at least for a while.
fade.zh: 但随着罗马帝国的衰落，香水在欧洲大部分地区的显赫地位黯然失色，至少有一段时间是这样。

fable.en: He had called the Old Testament "Ezra's fables," suggesting that the first part of the Bible was no more reliable than a myth.
fable.zh: 他把《旧约》称为“以斯拉的寓言”，暗示圣经的第一部分并不比神话更可靠。

faith.en: It had never been extended to cover Islam, or Judaism, or any other faith.
faith.zh: 它从未扩大到涵盖伊斯兰教、犹太教或任何其他信仰。

faith.en: Why are people losing faith in it? And is it dead or changing?
faith.zh: 为什么人们对它失去了信心？它究竟是消亡了还是在发生变化？

faith.en: That would give equal protection to Islam, Judaism, Hinduism, and every other faith.
faith.zh: 那将为伊斯兰教、犹太教、印度教以及其他所有信仰提供同等的保护。

faith.en: And this was such a wonderful avenue for us to do that, to really live out our faith.
faith.zh: 而这为我们提供了一个绝佳的途径，让我们能够真正践行我们的信仰。

faith.en: And my mother raised me in the Truth, which is how Jehovah's Witnesses colloquially refer to their faith.
faith.zh: 我妈妈是在“真理”中把我抚养长大的，这是耶和华见证人对他们信仰的俗称。

fate.en: But no definitive proof of Fawcett’s fate has ever come to light.
fate.zh: 但始终没有任何确凿的证据来证明 Fawcett 的最终命运。

fate.en: There was no hope. His parents made the agonising decision to remove his feeding tube, thus sealing his fate.
fate.zh: 已经没有希望了。他的父母痛苦地做出决定，撤掉他的喂食管，也因此为他的命运画上了句号。

fate.en: But while Gallipoli made him a hero, and provided plenty of soundbites to use later, it did not change the fate of the Ottoman Empire.
fate.zh: 但加里波利虽然让他成为了英雄，并为日后提供了大量金句，却并没有改变奥斯曼帝国的命运。

fate.en: But the story doesn't end there. The trial, and the ultimate fate of this boy-genius-turned-terrorist, would raise profound questions about responsibility, mental health, and the very nature of modern society.
fate.zh: 但故事并没有就此结束。审判以及这位天才少年变成的恐怖分子的最终命运，将引发关于责任、心理健康以及现代社会本质的深刻问题。

fate.en: And on the island, he also saw what fate awaited anyone who crossed the sadistic emperor: being pushed off a high cliff if they were lucky, and being slowly tortured to death if they weren’t.
fate.zh: 在这个岛上，他也看到了任何敢于顶撞这位残暴皇帝的人将面临的命运：幸运的话被推下高高的悬崖，不幸的话则被慢慢折磨致死。

fatal.en: And if your name is Otto Warmbier, fatal.
fatal.zh: 而如果你叫奥托·瓦姆比尔，这种残暴甚至可能是致命的。

fatal.en: Then, Morsi made a fatal miscalculation.
fatal.zh: 接着，Morsi 做出了一个致命的误判。

fatal.en: He seems to be on top of the world but makes a fatal miscalculation by choosing as his Vice President his equally ruthless wife.
fatal.zh: 他似乎登上了权力之巅，却犯下一个致命的误算，选择了他同样冷酷无情的妻子作为副总统。

fatal.en: And then you find out that there's been a bit of a miracle, I guess, because the bullet has missed all of the fatal parts of the head.
fatal.zh: 然后你发现发生了一个小小的奇迹，我想，因为子弹错过了头部所有致命的部分。

fatal.en: There are rumours he was poisoned, perhaps on Tiberius’ orders, or perhaps it was one of the many bugs that could have proved fatal for travelling soldiers back then.
fatal.zh: 有传言说他是被毒死的，也许是奉了 Tiberius 的命令，或者也许只是当时对旅行中的士兵来说致命的众多病毒之一。

fancy.en: Mike sat at a desk with six computer screens connected to millions of dollars worth of fancy analytic software designed by brilliant Ivy League graduates hired by his firm.
fancy.zh: Mike 的办公桌上摆着六台电脑屏幕，连接着价值数百万美元的精美分析软件，这些软件由他的公司雇佣的才华横溢的长春藤盟校毕业生设计。

fancy.en: To an outsider, it might look like the monarch’s job is just to turn up in fancy clothes and a crown, and there is an element of truth to that.
fancy.zh: 对外行人来说，君主的工作似乎只是穿着华丽的衣服戴着王冠露面，这确实有一定的道理。

fancy.en: He's this big guy, over six feet tall. And when he came back from Iraq a few years ago, he bought one of these fancy new mortgages with an adjustable rate.
fancy.zh: 他是个大个子，身高超过六英尺。几年前他从伊拉克回来后，买了一款这种带可调整利率的新潮抵押贷款。

faculty.en: We had a town hall meeting at which I spoke, and now the faculty were quite energized by the issue.
faculty.zh: 我们举行了一场市政厅式的会议，我在会上发了言，这时候教师们也一下子被这件事调动起来了。

faculty.en: After this, the most ambitious and wealthy students could progress to the higher faculties of law, medicine, and theology.
faculty.zh: 在此之后，最有野心和最富有的学生可以进入更高阶的法学、医学和神学系。

faculty.en: And so I think a lot of these mental faculties or these little frameworks or these isms just came from like, how can I combat this incredibly booming voice in the background?
faculty.zh: 所以我想，所有这些心智能力、这些小框架或这些主义，都来自于，我如何才能对抗背景中这个极其响亮的声音？

faculty.en: Sure. While our students generally wanted the name to be changed, our alumni did not, and our faculty at that point were largely not interested in this particular issue.
faculty.zh: 好的。当时我们的学生普遍希望改名，但我们的校友不希望，而我们的教师当时大多对这个具体议题并不太关心。

faculty.en: I mean, like, and he lost all his mental faculties, you know, almost sadly, basically when I stopped, when I left Baltimore, one of the sad parts is I was one of the only people that kind of like kept him lucid.
faculty.zh: 我的意思是，而且他失去了所有的心智能力，你知道的，甚至有点悲哀的是，基本上自我离开巴尔的摩后，令人难过的一点是，我是少数几个能让他保持清醒的人之一。

facilitate.en: Buy, use, buy, use, buy, use. The Silk Road facilitated this transaction, making ordering whatever drug you wanted as easy as clicking a few buttons on your computer.
facilitate.zh: 购买、使用、再买、再用、再买、再用。The Silk Road 促进了这种交易，让订购你想要的任何毒品变得像在电脑上点击几个按钮一样简单。

facilitate.en: Mubarak and his cronies had seen that this movement was being partially facilitated through social media - Facebook, Twitter and YouTube - and clearly thought that simply blocking this, switching it off, would bring about an end to it.
facilitate.zh: Mubarak 和他的亲信们看到这场运动部分是通过社交媒体——Facebook、Twitter 和 YouTube——来推动的，显然认为只要简单地封锁它、将其关闭，就能让这一切终结。

facilitate.en: So an athlete, they review game tape and they do mindset work and they've got a sports psychologist and they look at what they eat and they look at what they drink and they go to bed on time and they're hanging around with people that are growth-minded and they're getting the right coaches and then all the rest, everything is done. in order to facilitate performance in the thing that they say they care about.
facilitate.zh: 运动员会复盘比赛录像，进行心态训练，有运动心理学家，关注饮食，关注饮水，按时睡觉，与志同道合的人交往，聘请合适的教练，其余的一切，都是为了促进他们所关心的那件事的表现。

faint.en: I had a friend at high school who was really intelligent in class and did really well in all of the practice tests, but he got so nervous in exams that he kept fainting during high school.
faint.zh: 我在高中有个朋友，他在课堂上非常聪明，在所有练习测试中都表现得很好，但他一到考试就紧张得要命，在高中期间一直晕倒。

faint.en: As you might imagine, the courtroom was a mess: girls fainting, judges pushing for guilty verdicts, and even a ‘touch test’ where if an accused touched a girl and her fits stopped, it was proof of guilt.
faint.zh: 正如你所想象的那样，法庭上一团糟：女孩们昏厥，法官极力推动有罪判决，甚至还有一种“触摸测试”，如果被指控的人碰了一下女孩而女孩的抽搐停止了，这就成了有罪的证据。

fatigue.en: It's very, very random. Oftentimes, I've just learned sometimes it's fatigue.
fatigue.zh: 这非常、非常随机。通常，我只是了解到有时是疲劳。

fatigue.en: In fact, in his account, De Marchi would write that the limit to how long a diver could stay underwater with this invention was nothing to do with how much air there was left, but rather how long the diver could withstand the cold of the water and the fatigue of wearing this heavy contraption on their head.
fatigue.zh: 事实上，德马基在记述中写道，潜水员使用这项发明在水下停留时间的限制，与剩余多少空气无关，而是取决于潜水员能忍受多久的水温寒冷，以及头上戴着这个沉重装置的疲劳程度。

facility.en: More buildings and churches and facilities were built to deal with the growing population.
facility.zh: 为了应对不断增长的人口，更多的建筑、教堂和设施拔地而起。

facility.en: At the time, she ran the dining services department at a senior living facility.
facility.zh: 当时，她在一家高级生活护理中心管理餐饮服务部门。

facility.en: Instead, they came up with another use of Christmas Island… as a immigration detention facility.
facility.zh: 相反，他们想出了圣诞岛的另一个用途……作为一个移民拘留设施。

facility.en: The Guiana Space Center is Europe’s most important space launching facility.
facility.zh: 圭亚那太空中心是欧洲最重要的太空发射设施。

facet.en: And maybe in, you know, five years time you'll be like you know that thing that you said about the lessons and then i don't know it's cool that's like synthesis right it's this sort of blending of the reason i spend a lot of time in san francisco is because it's a gravitational attractor for the smartest people in the world and despite all the many problems the city had because it's mismanaged beyond belief it does just seem to pull in the young smart creative people not just the ones who are building technology but they're exploring every facet of life and they're weird and sometimes it's repulsive and it's bizarre but you talk to these people and you just see a very intelligent person coming at life in a completely different way putting it through the combinatorics of human dna which are uncountable and giving you a weird perspective that can twist your mind around and to do that you always have to be learning you you have you can't be the guru mentality If I'm with somebody and they're listening to every word I say and hanging on it, that's not interesting for me.
facet.zh: 也许五年后你会说，‘你知道你当时说的关于那些教训的事……’，我不知道，这很酷，这就是综合，对吧？这就是融合。我花很多时间在旧金山的原因是，它对世界上最聪明的人有一种引力吸引，尽管这座城市有许多问题，因为它管理得极其糟糕，但它似乎确实吸引了年轻、聪明、有创造力的人，不仅仅是那些搞技术的人，他们还在探索生活的方方面面，他们很古怪，有时甚至让人反感，很离奇，但你和这些人交谈，你会看到一个非常聪明的人以完全不同的方式对待生活，将其放入人类DNA的组合中，这些组合是数不胜数的，并给你一个奇怪的视角，可以扭转你的思维。要做到这一点，你必须始终保持学习，你不能有导师心态。如果我和某人在一起，他们听我说的每一个字，并对此深信不疑，那对我来说没意思。
